name: Last Letter 💬
desc:
Welcome to Last Letter! Play word games against people where every last letter counts, stay 2 steps ahead or you'll get eliminated💥

- NO P2W, every styles are viable and depends on how you use it 🧠
- Spin styles and use its ability to spice up the gameplay 🔥
- Get spins with codes, by logging in daily or by completing tasks 💰
- Buy items in shop to flex on people lol

The game is in beta, expect bugs and major changes

Join the group to redeem codes 🎁
if you enjoy and wish to support the game, Like 👍️ and Favorite ⭐️ for more updates

Searching answers mid game is against the rules but searching after is encouraged in order to learn new words
